data.verdict: HOLD read-only admission claim: lazy GameUserSettings getter can load/write before validation. No native isolation acceptance.

findings.title: Lazy graphics getter can perform IO before destination admission
findings.trigger: Valid controller/GI/subsystems and live lease, but GEngine.GameUserSettings is null. This is not rejected as an unsupported state; the predicate calls the creating getter before root/path/backend/class checks. A custom settings class may also be created before exact-class rejection.
sourceChain: SessionSettingsAdmission.cpp133 calls GEngine->GetGameUserSettings; root validation begins137, config and branch checks later
UnrealEngine.cpp17956-17962 getter calls CreateGameUserSettings if null
UnrealEngine.cpp17938-17943 calls LoadConfigIni, NewObject with configured class, SetToDefaults and LoadSettings
GameUserSettings.cpp603-653 loads effective config and writes SaveConfig(CPF_Config,*GGameUserSettingsIni) if deprecated window positions require migration
GameUserSettings.cpp700-745 LoadConfigIni also contains conditional low-integrity config migration copy
findings.impact: Predicate can reload config, invoke custom object code or write to an as-yet unvalidated effective destination even if it subsequently returns false. This contradicts its read-only/no-config-reload boundary; external startup caveats do not cover IO initiated by this predicate.
findings.correction: Use non-creating public GEngine->GameUserSettings.Get() readback (Engine.h872 public), require IsValid and exact stock class, and fail closed when uninitialized. Perform initialization only in explicitly audited bootstrap startup scope. Add source/real-UE validation for null and custom-class paths without fake UE.
findings.evidence: Actual installed source chain; no UE execution performed.

findings.title: Accepted root may generate paths runtime Canon must reject
findings.trigger: Valid230-character root made from three75-character components is accepted by launch_inputs. It returns Game.ini265chars,GameUserSettings.ini277chars,save directory251chars, all rejected by the same240-character canonical policy.
findings.impact: Generated launch contract may be impossible to admit after startup. Fail-closed availability defect, not isolation bypass.
findings.correction: Validate every derived directory/INI and longest supported actual save filename against Canon length/component policy before returning arguments. Keep runtime limits unchanged.

effectivePathAudit: Paths.cpp caches -UserDir on first use; ProjectUserDir uses it and GameSavedDir derives Saved plus optional suffix. GeneratedConfigDir is platform-driven: effective branch destinations, not generated intent alone, must remain checked.

Class.cpp GetConfigName returns logical Game for known configs. FindBranchWithNoReload resolves known/other branches; public IniPath is actual SaveBranch destination. SaveConfig may flush/delete destination or temp-write under ProjectSavedDir. Predicate excludes Default/GlobalUser/PerObject and inherited GlobalConfig redirections.

GameUserSettings SaveSettings uses GGameUserSettingsIni for scalability and SaveConfig; cloud delegate guards and exact stock class narrow write surface but getter side-effect defect precedes those guards.

Windows platform module caches a custom/generic backend; empty Engine config alone is insufficient. Exact equality against qualified base singleton correctly identifies stock generic path construction ProjectSavedDir+SaveGames+Name.sav.

Actual MakeSlotName uses00..SlotCount-1 then_Auto atSlotCount. Inclusive enumeration0..SlotCount and case-insensitive collision set correctly cover manual/autosave plus settings slot; users0 and count1..64 constrained.

Generic IFileManager is a stock static singleton; physical file-chain identity or one audited PakFile forwarding layer is conditional on trusted source/module closure. Wrapper name alone is not adversarial code authentication.
lifetimeAndFilesystemAudit: Callback captures strong lease and weak controller, reacquires actual GI subsystems on each invocation, and checks live lease at entry/exit. It does not capture dangling stack references or cache a true result. Existing mute caller rechecks ValidRemote and Authority fence after path IO.

Strong lease callback retention does not implement whole-process/async-save ownership. IOwnedSessionLease has no implementation here; supervisor must enforce immutable process/root/generation identities and retain root until saves/owned cleanup complete.

Win32 predicate walks drive/root/ancestors with no-follow opens, normalized final DOS equality, directory type, reparse and leaf hardlink-count checks; root volume+64bit file identity compared against lease. Only final files may be absent. This is source intent, not actual Win32 proof in this review.

Handles permit write/delete sharing and close before action; root identity is observed, not locked across later writes. ACL/exclusive-root/immutable-ancestor premises are essential and not implemented/tested here. Same-account untrusted writers can race if those premises are omitted.

Ignore-case ASCII equality, local fixed-drive limitation, strict components and exact expected paths avoid sibling-prefix acceptance. Unicode/UNC/long-path/custom-wrapper support deliberately refused.

Four pure-Python tests do not exercise FString canonicalization, Win32 no-follow semantics, CloseHandle failure, junction/hardlink/root identity or UE branch lookup. Gauss additive real-Windows tests are separate and were not modified or counted.
startupScope: Actual UMikdashSettingsSubsystem::Initialize calls Load then ApplyAll; graphics ApplySettings can SaveSettings before this remote mute callback. Existing manual/autosave/quit paths do not all invoke SettingsOwned.

UserDir/config/slot bootstrap and ACLs must be established before first cached paths/subsystem initialization. Successful remote predicate cannot retroactively prove earlier startup IO or future ungated writes isolated.
ToggleSound SaveConfig has no propagated persistence success receipt. This predicate can only conditionally admit destinations; no actual write-success claim.
